label: IMMENSE_2: infinite and causes the being of everything else
term: immense, typed by its grounds (immensus; Lean `IsImmenseAsInfiniteCauseOfAll`)
definition: IsImmenseAsInfiniteCauseOfAll InAct CausesIn esse Infinite g: g is INFINITE_1 (Infinite g, unreceived subsistent being, DEF-INFINITE) and g causes the being of every other being in act as to being (IsCreatorOfAll, definition 92c03350). After ST I q.7 a.1 (God's being is not received in anything, so it is not limited) and q.8 a.1 and a.3 (God is in all things as an agent is present to that on which it acts, and present to all things by essence as the cause of their being). Example: on the stage-two route, any being with the nine (infinity is one of the nine, and causing the being of everything else is contained by definition in supreme goodness). Counterexample: a cause of the being of everything else that is not infinite (Control.Controls part 2 of DeiFiliusImmenseIncomprehensible); an infinite being that causes nothing. Distinguished from IMMENSE_1 (the primitive Primitives.Immense, measured or contained by no place and present to everything that is): IMMENSE_2 types no place, containment or measure, and of the three modes of presence of q.8 a.3 it types only presence by essence as cause of being, not presence by power or by knowledge; nor does it type immediacy of presence (CausesIn does not distinguish mediate from immediate causing). Distinct from INFINITE_2 (quantitative or spatial infinity of extent): IMMENSE_2 involves no extent.
note: Analyst reading, attribution deferred: the Summa articles (q.7 a.1, q.8 a.1-4) motivate it; no claim states it. Sibling of IMMENSE_1 (disambiguation 3fc3ee02); the only passage between them is the open sense bridge 'Whatever is IMMENSE_2 is IMMENSE_1'. Structural properties: none built in. Both conjuncts are contained in the nine (infinity is one of them; the creator conjunct is contained by definition in the case's supreme goodness, DEF-SUPREMELY-GOOD), so deriving IMMENSE_2 from the nine is a definitional unfolding, not an independent warrant.
